source: 2016/TSB Vol 16 No 05 - New Plate adapter for Allison transmission.pdf
title: GM ATF Adapter Kit
lead: MOC has developed a new extension plate (Part No. 94924) to be used with Part No. 94783, the transmission adapter used on various vehicles with an Allison transmission.
body: See page 2 for pictures of the filter and mounting location.
This plate fits the Allison Spin-On transmission filter part number 29539579 and AC Delco Spin- On transmission filter part number TF950.
